integrity.computational_support: Eight independently generated finite examples, exact rational products, grid checks; VERIFY_OK 20687 assertions
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic common-neighbor identity, two-mode spectral reduction, weighted bilinear global bound and equality cases

scientific_limitations: The theorem minimizes centered Euclidean two-round contraction only for two scalar homogeneous gains, each nonnegative and at most the reciprocal graph degree. It does not optimize arbitrary edge-dependent, nonreversible or longer Markov schedules. Specialist historical overlap remains possible.
title: A common-neighbor phase transition in two-round stochastic mixing on strongly regular graphs
